title: Racehorse terminology — overseas racing English-Japanese dictionary
note: JRA's overseas-racing dictionary directly maps horse to the adult-male/general horse senses, foal to 当歳馬, yearling to 1歳馬, and broodmare sire to 母父. Use the mapped racing senses without asserting one jurisdiction's age conventions universally.

title: International Agreement on Breeding, Racing and Wagering — Article 12
note: IFHA Article 12 uses Foal, mating, exact date/country of foaling and requires mating/foaling details for Thoroughbred stud-book registration. Use as Thoroughbred-system evidence rather than a universal biological rulebook.

title: インブリード
note: JRA directly defines インブリード/近親交配 and its pedigree notation within Thoroughbred breeding.

title: 生産、育成関係、飼糧など — 種付
note: JRA directly defines 種付 as mating a stallion with a broodmare for breeding. Use to corroborate the breeding-action sense without collapsing distinct commercial service/right terminology.

title: Jockeys / licensing forms and information
note: BHA currently maintains Conditional Jockey licence/training arrangements and Amateur Rider permits/applications. Licence, age and allowance rules remain British-specific.

title: Racing Explained — Glossary
covers: Conditional jockey; Clerk of the Scales; Work rider; Yearling
note: Current glossary directly defines Conditional Jockey, Clerk Of The Scales, Work Rider and Yearling. Use British role definitions and one-year-old label without universalizing local licensing thresholds.

title: Exercise rider
note: JRA overseas-racing dictionary maps exercise rider to 攻馬手 and cross-references work rider.

title: 競馬に関わる人々 — オーナーブリーダー
note: JRA directly defines オーナーブリーダー as a breeder/production farm with owner status that races horses it bred.

title: Farrier
note: JRA directly maps farrier to 装蹄師 in overseas-racing terminology.

title: What is the role of the Clerk of the Scales?
note: BHA directly describes weighing riders/equipment before and after races and checking declared colours/headgear.
